cv.name: Rania Haroon
cv.headline: Junior Software Engineer: TypeScript, React and Node.js
cv.summary: Junior software engineer with two years of production TypeScript: React admin screens and the Node.js service behind them. Reviews pull requests for the billing team and writes things down; the on-call runbook the team uses is hers.

bullets: Built the React (TypeScript) admin screens for refunds and credit notes, including role-based access checks on the API side.
Built and maintain the invoicing service (Node.js, TypeScript, PostgreSQL) that issues about 9,000 invoices a month for the company’s logistics clients.
Review pull requests for the billing team; paired with two interns through their first month.
Moved four services from a hand-built VPS setup to Docker Compose with health checks and wrote the runbook the on-call rotation now uses.
Added unit tests to the ingestion scripts (pytest), raising coverage of the loader module from 0 to 71%.
Wrote Python scripts that cleaned and loaded retail sales CSVs into PostgreSQL for the analytics team (about 2 million rows a week).

projects.name: ledger-lite
projects.description: A small double-entry bookkeeping API in TypeScript (Fastify, PostgreSQL) that enforces balanced journal entries with a database constraint.

projects.name: Bus Tracker Lahore
projects.description: A React + Leaflet map of Metro Bus stops with estimated arrival gaps from public timetables.

projects.name: chai-check
projects.description: A browser extension that flags insecure form actions (HTTP, mixed content), built while working through the PortSwigger Web Security Academy.

education.details: CGPA 3.4 / 4.0. Final-year project: offline-first attendance app for rural schools (React Native, SQLite).

emphasis: Led with React and TypeScript, the editor stack
Pull-request review and the runbook show the writing and review habit Quillstack sells
Kept the Node.js invoicing service second as backend proof
